newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Silvermines trading in line with expectation.
newsitem.headline: Silvermines trading in line with expectation.

text.p: Silvermines Group Plc said on Wednesday that current trading was in line with expectations.
The group told shareholders at its annual meeting that it had had an encouraging performance from its Continental Mircowave Group, acquired in November 1996.
It has had an upsurge in orders from all over the world including its first contracts from China.

Silvermines also said that its export order intake from China, southeast Asia, the U.S. and Europe for its closed circuit television and building automation products was accelerating resulting from its investment in global marketing and new product development last year.
